business_summary: Yunnan Energy New Material (Group) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides film products in China and internationally. The company offers lithium-ion battery separator; BOPP films comprising cigarette film, flat film and special film; as well as special paper products, such as laser transfer anti-counterfeiting paper, direct-plated paper, and glassine paper. It also provides packaging printing products, including cigarette label and aseptic packaging products; and paper packaging, comprising special paper, holographic anti-counterfeiting anodized aluminum, and other products. In addition, the company offers investment and technical services; engages in trading activities; buys and sells real estate; and produces and sales new materials. The company was formerly known as Yunnan Energy New Material Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yunnan Energy New Material (Group) Co., Ltd. in January 2026. Yunnan Energy New Material (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Yuxi, China.
